about: A task and time-tracking plugin for Obsidian with calendar integration.

prs.title: Due-only tasks land on their due date in calendars
prs.broken: A task with only a due date was exported as an event from its creation time to the due date, so it showed on every day except the one it was due.
prs.changed: A task with only a due date is now exported as an event on its due date.
prs.matters: Calendar apps that read the feed show tasks on the right day.
